title: How Enterprises are Reshaping Strategy with Agentic AI | Endava
summary: This exclusive report from BARC, produced in collaboration with Endava, reveals why 2025 marks a turning point for agent-based automation.
body_markdown:
Agentic AI: Streamlining the Subtle and Complex


Agentic AI, and Endava’s Morpheus accelerator, deliver on the promise of generative AI with accuracy and adaptability. By assembling collaborative teams of AI agents with defined roles, insurers can tackle complex processes like claims handling and onboarding. This solution balances creativity with control, offering transparency, regulation-readiness and robust automation for real-world enterprise challenges.


Read the article


Empowering Industries With Agentic AI


Endava’s agentic AI solution redefines enterprise automation with multi-agent teams capable of handling nuanced tasks in regulated industries. Combining transparency, data integrity and LLM/cloud-agnostic flexibility, it frees businesses from rigid systems. Morpheus enables scalable, dynamic workflows in insurance, healthcare and finance and empowers organisations to evolve and innovate with confidence while meeting strict compliance standards.


Visit our collection


What is Agentic AI?


Agentic AI goes beyond traditional AI by enabling systems to make autonomous, contextual decisions. Designed to act like human partners, these agents execute complex workflows, adapt in real-time and integrate seamlessly with enterprise systems. From proactive personal assistants to intelligent data processors, this evolution marks a shift toward more human-like, purpose-driven AI across industries.
